title: Boot Reliability Aggregate
description: Boot certification matrix (TODO-28 boot validation). The aggregate a boot-reliability run emits: N cold + M warm reboot iterations of one launcher on one (row, platform_class, tier), classified per iteration and reduced to a flake decision. Each iterations[] entry mirrors a result.schema.json run plus its iteration index and cold/warm phase. The release gate (S9) consumes decision + flake_count + flake_threshold; result.schema.json (S1) is the single-run shape and stays frozen.

cold_count.description: cold-boot iterations requested (fresh firmware NVRAM + reset boot.conf)

warm_count.description: warm-reboot iterations requested (firmware NVRAM + disk state reused from the series)

flake_count.description: iterations that ran but did not pass (fail + degraded + timeout); skips excluded

flake_threshold.description: max tolerated flakes for this tier; 0 for stable

classifier_version.description: boot-log classifier contract version; bump when PASS/FAIL/required semantics change so old aggregates are not silently re-interpreted

iterations.description: one entry per executed iteration in run order

logs.description: captured serial / screenshot / BlackBox artifact paths for this iteration
